References can include calls, fields, type uses and function values; they do not prove invocation. External and dynamic calls may be missing. Inspect source call sites before describing runtime behavior. Legacy result direction labels callers/callees mean incoming/outgoing references; semantics reports their interpretation and coverage. max_nodes includes the queried root; max_edges separately bounds relationships. Symbols are fuzzy-matched; unresolved names return a note.

"""Model-free strict product/source check for static-reference delivery."""
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
CHECKOUT = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit')
RUN = ROOT / sys.argv[1]
RUN.mkdir()
REPO = RUN / 'source'
SEED = Path('/tmp/codenib-matched-pilot-20261027/sources/pallets__flask')
shutil.copytree(SEED, REPO, symlinks=True)
os.environ['CODENIB_HOME'] = str(RUN / '.codenib')
os.environ['CODENIB_TOOLCHAIN_DIR'] = '/home/zhongming/.codenib/toolchains'
os.environ['CODENIB_PYTHON_LSP_CMD'] = '/tmp/codenib-codegraph-identity-next/toolchain/basedpyright-langserver --stdio'
os.environ['PYTHONPATH'] = str(CHECKOUT)
sys.path.insert(0, str(CHECKOUT))

from codenib.agent.boundary import AGENT_LINE_OFFSET
from codenib.cli import index_repository
from codenib.graph.code_graph import CodeGraph
from codenib.graph.dependency import DependencyAnalyzer
from codenib.types import EDGE_TYPE_REFERENCE, NODE_TYPE_FIELD
from mcp import Client, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

receipt = {
    'scope': 'Model-free developer regression on the historically exposed pinned Flask source. Fresh strict SCIP/BM25 build and real MCP 2.3 stdio. No task-benefit, model-improvement, SDK inference or external-user claim.',
    'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'controller_sha256': sha(__file__),
    'base_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=CHECKOUT, text=True).strip(),
    'implementation_sha256': {name: sha(CHECKOUT / name) for name in [
        'codenib/mcp/server.py', 'codenib/mcp/prompts.py', 'codenib/mcp/tools/dependency.py', 'codenib/graph/dependency.py']},
    'calls': [], 'checks': [], 'model_inference_sessions': 0,
}

def save():
    (RUN / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')

def snapshot():
    files = {str(p.relative_to(REPO)): sha(p) for p in sorted(REPO.rglob('*'))
             if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.relative_to(REPO).parts}
    return {'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip(),
            'git_status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], cwd=REPO, text=True),
            'files': files}

def project(payload):
    return json.loads(next(p['text'] for p in payload['content'] if p['type'] == 'text'))

async def call(client, name, args):
    start = time.monotonic()
    raw = (await client.call_tool(name, arguments=args)).model_dump(mode='json')
    receipt['calls'].append({'name': name, 'arguments': args, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'payload': raw})
    save()
    assert raw['is_error'] is False, raw
    return project(raw)

async def main():
    receipt['source_before'] = snapshot()
    started = time.monotonic()
    manifest, failed = await asyncio.to_thread(index_repository, REPO, languages=('python',), views=('bm25', 'symbol_graph'),
        allow_graph_project_preparation=False, allow_partial_graph_languages=False)
    receipt['build_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
    receipt['failed_views'] = failed
    receipt['manifest'] = manifest.to_dict()
    assert not failed, failed
    assert receipt['manifest']['indexes']['symbol_graph']['status'] == 'fresh'
    graph_path = Path(receipt['manifest']['indexes']['symbol_graph']['path']) / 'graph.pkl'
    graph = CodeGraph.load_graph(str(graph_path))
    analyzer = DependencyAnalyzer(graph)
    symbol = 'src/flask/app.py:Flask.make_response()'
    with (RUN / 'mcp.stderr').open('w') as errors:
        transport = stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command=sys.executable,
            args=['-m', 'codenib', 'mcp', str(REPO), '--tool-surface', 'full'], env=dict(os.environ), cwd=RUN), errlog=errors)
        async with Client(transport, mode='auto', cache=None) as client:
            tools = {t.name: t for t in (await client.list_tools()).tools}
            receipt['tool_description'] = tools['dependency_subgraph'].description
            assert 'static-reference' in receipt['tool_description']
            for direction, method, expected_direction in [('dependencies', analyzer.dependencies, 'outgoing'), ('impact', analyzer.impact, 'incoming'), ('both', analyzer.subgraph, 'both')]:
                data = await call(client, 'dependency_subgraph', {'symbol': symbol, 'direction': direction, 'depth': 1, 'max_nodes': 60, 'max_edges': 400})
                metadata = data.pop('semantics')
                assert metadata['edge_type'] == EDGE_TYPE_REFERENCE
                assert metadata['reference_direction'] == expected_direction
                assert 'type use' in metadata['interpretation'] and 'dynamic' in metadata['coverage']
                options = {'max_nodes': 60, 'max_edges': 400, 'radius' if direction == 'both' else 'max_depth': 1}
                expected = method(symbol, **options).to_dict()
                for node in expected['nodes']:
                    if isinstance(node.get('line'), int):
                        node['line'] += AGENT_LINE_OFFSET
                assert data == expected, (direction, data, expected)
                if direction == 'dependencies':
                    alias = 'src/flask/typing.py:ResponseReturnValue'
                    assert next(n for n in data['nodes'] if n['name'] == alias)['kind'] == NODE_TYPE_FIELD
                    assert {'source': symbol, 'target': alias, 'type': EDGE_TYPE_REFERENCE} in data['edges']
                receipt['checks'].append({'direction': direction, 'canonical_reference_direction': expected_direction, 'legacy_payload_equals_persisted_graph_analysis': True})
            annotation = await call(client, 'read_source', {'file_path': 'src/flask/app.py', 'start_line': 1732, 'end_line': 1732})
            assert 'rv: ft.ResponseReturnValue' in annotation['content']
            alias_source = await call(client, 'read_source', {'file_path': 'src/flask/typing.py', 'start_line': 32, 'end_line': 35})
            assert 'ResponseReturnValue' in alias_source['content']
            status = await call(client, 'get_manifest', {})
            assert status['runtime']['source_read']['verified'] is True
    receipt['source_after'] = snapshot()
    assert receipt['source_before'] == receipt['source_after']
    receipt['status'] = 'passed'

try:
    asyncio.run(main())
except BaseException as error:
    receipt['status'] = 'failed'
    receipt['failure'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error), 'traceback': traceback.format_exc()}
finally:
    receipt['finished_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    save()
    print(json.dumps({'status': receipt['status'], 'calls': len(receipt['calls']), 'failure': receipt.get('failure')}))

"""Retain the model-free control without changing earlier study artifacts."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
REPO = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit')
OUT = REPO / 'docs/experiments'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

class StripDocs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def generic_visit(self, node):
        super().generic_visit(node)
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Module, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
            if node.body and isinstance(node.body[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.body[0].value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.body[0].value.value, str):
                node.body.pop(0)
        return node

base = '8b47a82165ceade7f96b2cf2a58421c540a86732'
path = 'codenib/graph/dependency.py'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', base + ':' + path], cwd=REPO, text=True)
assert ast.dump(StripDocs().visit(ast.parse(old))) == ast.dump(StripDocs().visit(ast.parse((REPO / path).read_text())))
raw_path = ROOT / 'flask1/receipt.json'
receipt = json.loads(raw_path.read_text())
assert receipt['status'] == 'passed' and len(receipt['calls']) == 6
assert receipt['source_before'] == receipt['source_after']
for name, digest in receipt['implementation_sha256'].items():
    assert sha(REPO / name) == digest
frozen = {}
for pattern in ['codegraph_matched_*', 'codegraph_agent_recovery*']:
    for item in OUT.glob(pattern):
        tracked = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-files', '--error-unmatch', str(item.relative_to(REPO))], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True)
        if tracked.returncode == 0:
            expected = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', base + ':' + str(item.relative_to(REPO))], cwd=REPO)
            assert expected == item.read_bytes()
            frozen[item.name] = sha(item)
archive = {
    'schema_version': 1, 'scope': 'Model-free source and MCP semantics regression; no new benefit comparison, model-improvement result or external-user claim.',
    'original_receipt_sha256': sha(raw_path), 'receipt': receipt,
    'executed_controller': {'sha256': sha(ROOT / 'check.py'), 'source': (ROOT / 'check.py').read_text()},
    'graph_runtime_ast_equals_baseline': base,
    'validation': {'targeted_mcp_2_0_passed': 39, 'targeted_mcp_2_3_passed': 39,
                   'mcp_2_3_unit': {'passed':447,'skipped':7,'deselected':7},
                   'local_unit': {'passed':8845,'skipped':24,'deselected':221,'warnings':46,'seconds':144.72}},
    'prior_study_files_unchanged': frozen, 'model_inference_sessions': 0,
    'external_participants': 0, 'product_release': 'Source fix only; public PyPI 0.2.4 is unchanged.',
    'archive_implementation': {'sha256': sha(__file__), 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
target = OUT / 'codegraph_reference_semantics_2026_10_28.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(archive, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': target.name, 'bytes': target.stat().st_size, 'prior_artifacts_unchanged': len(frozen)}))
